<!-- METHODS -->

<div class="panel">

<h2>
Methodology
</h2>

<p class="small">

The earthquake spreadsheet was inspected and cleaned
using Python and Pandas. Latitude, longitude and
magnitude were validated before converting the records
to Point geometries using GeoPandas and Shapely.

The spatial reference system used was EPSG:4326.

Earthquake concentration was measured using a
10° × 10° latitude-longitude grid. The concentration
index represents the percentage of cleaned events
located within the most populated grid cell.

</p>

</div>


<!-- LIMITATIONS -->

<div class="panel">

<h2>
Interpretation and Limitations
</h2>

<p class="small">

The concentration analysis is a descriptive spatial
index and should not be interpreted as a seismic hazard
or risk map. Results can change with grid size and
time period. Historical earthquake records may also
contain differences in detection, reporting,
completeness, missing attributes and spatial coverage.

</p>

</div>
